id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_190.pack|cs_: "Somebody! Anybody! Is no one alive!? Sire! Where are you!!
"...Somebody.
"...That sound!!
"Woof! Woof! Woof!

Now the song of joy rings out
Morning has come, morning has come
Light of tomorrow shines on us

Eagles soar to praise us
Pure mountain waters will heal us

Sing, people of Heliodor
Sun folk of strong heart
Sing, sing the song of joy
"Hendrik... You did it! You truly did it!
"Out of the way! Please, let me through!!
"It was too dark to see before, but... how handsome you've become! Hee hee, you're truly my son!
"{var:1}, with Hendrik you have brought back the sun. I thank you.
"But the world is still in chaos. You are the Luminary, its hope! Please restore light to Erdrea."
"Hendrik, you have fought well for our kingdom. Tonight's victory was thanks to your strength.
"Now your sword must serve the world. You understand what I mean?
"Do not worry about the fortress. My people are strong. And so am I... Ha ha ha!
"There is nothing to agonize over. Your heart was made up long ago, was it not?
"{var:1}, our Luminary. From today, I entrust my life to you.
Hendrik joined the party!
"Everyone, the night is over! ...Victory is ours!!
The celebration at the sun-restored Last Bastion lasted a day and a night, and songs of joy echoed through the mountains.
...And then, dawn broke!
